description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories, Inc. (SEL) is hiring a software engineer focused on Linux backend development. The role develops software solutions for the electric power industry and collaborates with software, firmware, and power systems teams.
Embedded systems software engineer developing Linux security solutions and integrating hardware, firmware, and power systems

Responsibilities:
• Work from high-level requirements and customer commitments to deliver innovative solutions and delight our customers
• Work cooperatively with a team of like-minded individuals
• Participate in reviewing specifications, designs, code, and tests in tight collaboration with other team members
• Understand hardware and software interactions; collaborate with firmware and power system engineers
• Participate in project planning and estimation
• Follow and apply SEL Values and Principles of Operation
• Understand. Create. Simplify
• Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
• Solid understanding of object-oriented principles and concepts
• Knowledge and experience in object-oriented languages (e.g., C++, C#, etc.)
• Knowledge and experience in Linux
• Strong writing, documentation, and speaking skills
• Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities
• Ability to work cooperatively in a team environment

Preferred:
• 1-3 years software development experience
• Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, best practices, and standards
• Familiarity with Git, CMake, and Docker
• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Jenkins
